summary.identity_policy: Case-folded normalized name plus normalized endpoint; product paths/subdomains preserved; aliases not merged.
summary.metric_policy: Nonnegative integer metrics only; blanks are missing; invalid values excluded from totals and counted.
summary.source_row_policy: 1-based data-record index, excluding header; join to original records using this index.
summary.event_policy: All accepted records count; no duplicate event-ID removal.
summary.scope: Extraction only; no AI labels or categories assigned.

ingestion.event_map_note: 30000 mappings omitted only from this checked-in summary. Full CLI reports retain them.

limitations: Sadit ingestion counts every accepted record, including repeated event IDs; rejected rows are reported separately.
Application identity includes name and endpoint; it is not simply a hostname count.
Catalog categories and labels are supplied assignments, not independently verified truth.
Unknown or ambiguous applications remain visible; models require supplied descriptions.
Governance uses accepted activity and explicit company synthetic overlays only; no generated catalog controls are imported.
Low priority with incomplete evidence is not assurance of safety. No web/API calls occur.
The reconciled binary and 14-category models remain experimental; catalog categories are supplied labels.
